**About the Company**

Lightning Rod Labs develops AI systems designed to predict real-world outcomes. The company trains large language models (LLMs) using scalable self-play and unstructured data, helping enterprises build custom predictive models without requiring manual data extraction.

Its approach has demonstrated that smaller models, including 14B and 32B parameter models, can outperform frontier models on prediction-market benchmarks using generated data.

**About the Role**

Lightning Rod Labs is looking for an engineer to build and scale systems that help AI models develop real-world reasoning and prediction capabilities. You will work across data processing, model training, distributed infrastructure, experimentation, and deployment.

The role focuses on developing prediction agent infrastructure, orchestrating large-scale GPU workloads, transforming unstructured data into training signals, and improving model performance through reinforcement learning, self-play, and probability calibration.

This is a remote-first position, with a growing team hub in Brooklyn / New York City preferred. Meaningful working-hour overlap with the Eastern Time Zone is required.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Create and evolve infrastructure for training and serving prediction agents.
* Orchestrate distributed training and inference across large, multi-node GPU clusters.
* Convert unstructured data streams into useful training signals for model learning and evaluation.
* Design training objectives, reward systems, and calibration methods that help models identify causal factors and produce well-calibrated probabilities.
* Optimize training frameworks, fine-tune models, and run experiments to achieve strong benchmark results.
* Build scalable data and training pipelines, from initial data collection through deployment.
* Take ownership of major technical components and deliver systems from design to production.

**Required Qualifications**

* Strong Python programming skills and experience fine-tuning large language models.
* Demonstrated experience delivering impactful technical systems.
* Ability to work independently, take ownership, and operate with autonomy.
* A portfolio of technical work, such as GitHub projects, research papers, demos, or other evidence of engineering skills.
* Experience working beyond small-scale experiments, including millions of samples and large distributed GPU clusters.
* Ability to move between rapid notebook-based analysis and the development of reliable, scalable data and training pipelines.
* Experience with tools and frameworks such as Verl, Hugging Face, PyTorch, pandas, and standard machine learning training and data tools.
* Strong understanding of statistics, probability, data quality, and machine learning best practices.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms, including Modal, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Microsoft Azure, and Amazon Web Services (AWS).

**What You’ll Gain**

* The opportunity to advance LLM training methods for prediction using reinforcement learning and self-play.
* The chance to contribute to a framework designed to help AI learn from unstructured data and develop new predictive capabilities.
* Exposure to important applications across defense, healthcare, and major institutions.
* Ownership of significant parts of the technology stack, from design through delivery.
* A high-trust, fast-paced working environment with autonomy to set direction and deliver frequently.
* Close collaboration with a small team across product, engineering, and customer functions, connecting research with real-world applications.

**Description**
Amazon DynamoDB powers many of the world's fastest-growing businesses, including Lyft, Airbnb, and Redfin. It also powers enterprises such as Samsung, Toyota, and Capital One. Within Amazon, it runs high-traffic properties including Alexa, Amazon.com, and every Amazon fulfillment center. DynamoDB is one of the largest distributed database systems in the world. We believe it is always Day 1, and we keep improving the service and adding new capabilities.
  
  
DynamoDB customers count on consistent single-digit millisecond performance at any scale, high availability, and durable data. Testing is how DynamoDB keeps those promises with every change it ships. The Test Infrastructure team build test frameworks that every DynamoDB engineer uses to validate features, run integration and performance tests, and qualify releases. When test infrastructure is fast and reliable, every DynamoDB team delivers features faster.
  
  
Testing is also central to how DynamoDB speeds up delivery as engineers bring AI agents into their development work. An agent can only correct its own mistakes if it can run a change against a realistic system and see the result. Ready-to-run test clusters give agents that feedback loop. The features developed by this team allows DynamoDB engineers to use AI-assisted development for changes that need more than unit tests, and they let DynamoDB add automated testing to every code review and every release.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Design, build, and operate the test clusters, frameworks, and tooling that power DynamoDB testing.
* Build test infrastructure that AI agents can use on their own, with clusters ready on demand and results, logs, and metrics an agent can act on.
* Treat DynamoDB engineers as your customers. Cut how long they wait for test results and how often their tests fail because of infrastructure.
* Own features end to end, from design through deployment and operation, and deliver ambiguous projects with minimal guidance.
* Debug failures across services and fix root causes in the system.

**Responsibilities**
The Data-AML-Engine Orchestration team builds large-scale machine learning infrastructure that powers online model serving across ByteDance products, including TikTok. We develop the orchestration, scheduling, and resource management systems that connect heterogeneous compute infrastructure with production ML workloads.
  
  
You will work on systems that directly affect GPU utilization, serving latency and availability, infrastructure reliability, and MLE productivity. Depending on your background and interests, you may focus on one or more of the following areas.
  
  
We are looking for talented individuals to join us for an internship. Our internship program offers students hands-on experience, industry exposure, and opportunities to apply their knowledge to real-world challenges while building a strong foundation for personal and professional growth.
  
  
Interns will gain practical experience, explore potential career paths, and participate in social events, learning programs, and development workshops alongside industry professionals.
  
  
Candidates may apply to a maximum of two positions across Our Company and its affiliates globally. Applications will be considered in the order they are submitted.
  
  
Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, so we encourage you to apply early. Please clearly state your availability in your resume, including your start and end dates.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Design and build foundational orchestration capabilities for machine learning platforms, including Kubernetes Operators, container runtimes, and lifecycle management for jobs, services, and stateful workloads.
* Build multi-tenant resource and quota systems that support priorities, preemption, fair sharing, elasticity, and cross-cluster scheduling. Improve GPU utilization and cost efficiency through resource pooling and FinOps.
* Build lifecycle orchestration for online model serving, including model and image distribution, deployment, upgrades, rollback, autoscaling, multi-cluster operation, and disaster recovery.
* Build serving orchestration and traffic management capabilities for disaggregated serving clusters, including topology-aware scheduling, KV Cache affinity, intelligent request routing, and QoS/SLA management.

**Qualifications**
Minimum Qualifications:
  
  

* Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, or a related technical field.
* Proficiency in at least one of Go, C++, or Python, with a solid foundation in data structures, algorithms, and software engineering principles.
* Familiarity with Linux and a foundational understanding of operating systems, computer networks, concurrent programming, and distributed systems.
* Strong hands-on and exploratory abilities, with a willingness to investigate systems through source code, metrics, logs, profiling, and experiments.
* A systematic and quantitative approach to problem solving, with the ability to define measurements, test hypotheses, and validate system improvements.
* Demonstrated ownership and collaboration through coursework, research, internships, open-source contributions, or other engineering projects.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with Kubernetes, container runtimes, resource scheduling, quota management, multi-tenant systems, or FinOps.
* Contributions to open-source infrastructure projects such as Kubernetes, Volcano, Koordinator, or OpenKruise.
* Experience with model serving systems such as vLLM, SGLang, Triton, KServe, or Ray Serve, or an understanding of KV Cache, Continuous Batching, Prefill/Decode disaggregation, or model parallelism.
* Experience with online services, gateways, traffic management, autoscaling, performance optimization, or highly available distributed systems.
* Experience with GPU/NPU programming, heterogeneous resource scheduling, model distribution, or inference performance analysis.

**Responsibilities**
The Applied Machine Learning Ark team combines system engineering and machine learning to develop and operate Large Language Model (LLM) service platforms that offer businesses Model-as-a-Service (MaaS) solutions, serving both large model providers and downstream users. The US team drives the design, development, and operation of MaaS solutions across the US and international markets outside mainland China. We are building full-stack, end-to-end solutions spanning text and multimodal LLM algorithms, LLM training/fine-tuning/inference frameworks, prompt engineering, model alignment, and intelligent agent systems. Beyond model serving, we operate large-scale log analytics pipelines that process massive volumes of invocation logs from text models, multimodal models, and agent systems — extracting usage patterns, quality signals, and actionable insights to inform model improvement, system optimization, and product decisions through continuous, data-driven feedback loops. We are actively seeking talented engineers and researchers specializing in Large Language Models and AI Agent systems to join our dynamic team.
  
  
We are looking for talented individuals to join our team. As a graduate, you will get opportunities to pursue bold ideas, tackle complex challenges, and unlock limitless growth.
  
  
Successful candidates must be able to commit to an onboarding date by the end of the year. Please state your availability and graduation date clearly in your resume.
  
  
Candidates can apply to a maximum of two positions and will be considered for jobs in the order you apply. The application limit is applicable to our Company and its affiliates' jobs globally. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis - we encourage you to apply early.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Design evaluation systems for LLM-based agents, covering task success, tool use, reasoning quality, and reliability.
* Build benchmarks and automated judging pipelines, combining rule-based checks, model-based judging, and human review, etc.
* Analyze agent execution traces and user feedback to identify failure patterns and turn them into concrete system improvements.
* Support the closed loop from experience to capability, and work with research, platform, and product teams to bring methods into production.

**Qualifications**
Minimum Qualifications:
  
  

* Individuals who are completing or have recently completed a Bachelor's/ Master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science, or a related field.
* Solid foundation in machine learning and deep learning.
* Hands-on experience with LLM-based systems (e.g., agents, tool calling, retrieval, multi-agent systems) through research, internships, or projects.
* Strong Python skills and experience with a mainstream ML or agent evaluation framework.
* Demonstrated research or engineering ability through publications, substantial projects, internships, or open-source work.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Publications at top-tier ML/NLP venues (e.g., NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ACL etc.), especially in agent learning, self-improving/self-evolving/RSI, or agent evaluation.
* Experience with evaluation methodology: metric design, model-based judging, or annotation and statistical analysis, etc.
* Familiarity with LLM post-training, reasoning and planning methods, or continual learning.
* Experience with feedback-driven optimization loops, or with large-scale log and trace analysis.

**Responsibilities**
About the Team
  
  
The Traffic Infrastructure (TI) team leverages unified platform capabilities to manage global edge infrastructure (both self-built and third-party), providing standardized, compliant, scalable, and cost-effective traffic infrastructure capabilities for edge services. Our vision is to build a global edge traffic infrastructure platform and become the long-term cornerstone of ByteDance's global edge business in terms of scale, performance, and cost.
  
  
As a New Grad engineer, you will join a team of experienced infrastructure engineers who will mentor you as you grow. You will work on real production systems that serve global edge traffic at massive scale, gaining hands-on exposure to cloud-native technologies, distributed systems, and networking from day one.
  
  
We are looking for talented individuals to join our team. As a graduate, you will get opportunities to pursue bold ideas, tackle complex challenges, and unlock limitless growth.
  
  
Successful candidates must be able to commit to an onboarding date by the end of the year. Please state your availability and graduation date clearly in your resume.
  
  
Candidates can apply to a maximum of two positions and will be considered for jobs in the order you apply. The application limit is applicable to our Company and its affiliates' jobs globally. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis - we encourage you to apply early.
  
  
Candidates who pass resume screening will be invited to participate in Our Company's technical online assessment.
  
  
What You Will Do
  
  

* Contribute to the design, development, and operation of infrastructure components for global edge PoPs (e.g., Kubernetes/control plane, virtualization/containers, Ingress/Gateway), with guidance from mentor engineers, focusing on performance, reliability, and security.
* Participate in the end-to-end delivery of cloud-native features — from requirements and implementation to testing and production rollout — while learning our engineering best practices.
* Help build observability and troubleshooting tooling (metrics/logs/tracing/profiling) and contribute to automation that improves incident response efficiency.
* Collaborate with SRE, platform, and product teams, and grow into an engineer who can independently own standardized, reusable platform capabilities for traffic-intensive services.

**Qualifications**
Minimum Qualifications
  
  

* Individuals who are currently pursuing or recently completed a BS/MS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field, graduating within the past year or by the expected start date.
* Solid foundation in software engineering fundamentals (data structures, algorithms, operating systems, computer networks).
* Programming experience in one or more languages such as Go, C or Rust, demonstrated through coursework, personal projects, internships, or open-source contributions.
* Familiarity with Linux and basic understanding of containers, distributed systems, or networking concepts.
* Strong problem-solving skills, a growth mindset, ownership, and eagerness to learn in a collaborative, fast-paced environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Internship, co-op, or research experience related to backend/systems development, cloud-native technologies, or infrastructure.
* Hands-on exposure to containers and Kubernetes through coursework, side projects, or internships (e.g., deploying applications, basic cluster operations, service discovery, Ingress/Gateway).
* Contributions to cloud-native open-source projects (e.g., Kubernetes, Containerd, Cilium/eBPF), even at a small scale.
* Deeper Linux knowledge (kernel, scheduling, TCP/IP, routing, iptables/nftables) gained through projects or self-study.
* Coursework, projects, or curiosity around CDN, live streaming, RTC, or other edge/traffic-intensive architectures.

**About the Company**

iAdeptive Technologies is an 8(a) small business providing data, cloud, and AI engineering services to federal mission programs. The company focuses on building secure, scalable, and audit-ready systems. Its teams include architects and engineers who take a hands-on approach to designing and developing technology solutions, with security and governance built into the process.

**About the Role**

iAdeptive Technologies is seeking a Machine Learning Engineer to lead model development for a federal data and AI program. The role focuses on self-supervised representation learning using tabular and temporal administrative data, language-model-based information extraction from unstructured records, supervised classification, model calibration, and explainability.

You will work with large, linked datasets inside an access-restricted analytical environment with approved tools, no external connectivity, and CPU-only computing resources.

This is primarily a modeling position rather than a data pipeline role. You will own model architecture selection, training, calibration, and validation, applying strong quantitative judgment throughout the development process. Data engineering will support the models but will not be the primary focus.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Representation Learning**

* Design and train self-supervised tabular transformers, including SAINT, TabTransformer, and FT-Transformer, as well as temporal sequence models using longitudinal event data.
* Ensure outcome labels are withheld during pretraining.
* Select pretraining objectives, conduct pilot runs, and validate embedding quality before proceeding with full-scale training.
* Benchmark candidate architectures against gradient-boosted baselines and document comparative results.

**Language Model-Based Information Extraction**

* Deploy locally hosted, open-weight language models to extract structured information from unstructured text.
* Design prompts, constrained output schemas, and post-processing workflows.
* Quantize and optimize models for high-volume CPU-only inference while maintaining acceptable extraction accuracy.
* Implement dual-coding evaluation protocols using stratified sampling, independent human coding, and field-level agreement measurements.
* Report extraction accuracy before beginning large-scale processing.

**Supervised Modeling & Calibration**

* Train gradient-boosted classifiers, including LightGBM and XGBoost, using learned embeddings under severe class imbalance.
* Calibrate classification thresholds on validation data while explicitly accounting for the cost of different error types.
* Report calibration curves alongside discrimination metrics.
* Detect and prevent data leakage across temporal splits and linked record sources.

**Model Explainability**

* Generate additive feature attributions using SHAP at the individual-prediction level.
* Aggregate explanations across cohorts and subgroups.
* Verify attribution stability across model retraining and assess consistency with domain expectations.

**Supporting Data & MLOps**

* Maintain the feature and inference pipelines supporting the models using Spark, Parquet, and Python.
* Version datasets, models, and experiments in MLflow.
* Ensure reported results can be reproduced from recorded MLflow runs.

**Mathematical Foundation**

Strong applied mathematical knowledge is central to this position and will be assessed during the interview.

* **Probability & Statistical Inference:**
  Understanding of estimators, bias and variance, sampling distributions, confidence intervals, and calibration curves.
* **Linear Algebra & Optimization:**
  Knowledge of gradient-based optimization, regularization, convexity and its limitations in deep networks, and attention as matrix operations.
* **Information Theory:**
  Understanding of cross-entropy, KL divergence, and loss functions used in self-supervised and contrastive learning.
* **Evaluation Theory:**
  Understanding of discrimination versus calibration, ROC and precision-recall behavior under class imbalance, and threshold selection based on expected cost.
* **Causal Reasoning:**
  Ability to identify confounding and data leakage, including features that encode an outcome or a downstream consequence of it.

**Technical Stack**

* **Tabular Representation Learning:**
  SAINT, TabTransformer, FT-Transformer, masked-feature reconstruction, and contrastive pretraining objectives.
* **Temporal & Sequence Modeling:**
  Transformer encoders over ordered event sequences, including BEHRT-style models, and temporal convolutional networks.
* **Language Models:**
  Locally hosted open-weight instruction-tuned models from the Llama, Mistral, and Qwen families; quantized CPU inference using llama.cpp or equivalent tools.
* **Supervised Learning:**
  LightGBM, XGBoost, CatBoost, and scikit-learn.
* **Deep Learning:**
  PyTorch.
* **Explainability:**
  SHAP, including TreeSHAP and KernelSHAP, and integrated gradients.
* **Data & MLOps:**
  Spark, Parquet, pandas, NumPy, and MLflow for experiment tracking and model versioning.
* **Environment:**
  Cloud-hosted, access-restricted analytical environments.

**Required Qualifications**

* 3+ years of experience training and deploying machine learning models, including end-to-end ownership of at least one system from raw data through validated results.
* Hands-on experience training transformer architectures in PyTorch, including at least one self-supervised or contrastive learning objective on non-text data.
* Experience deploying open-weight language models for structured information extraction, with accuracy measured against a labeled reference dataset.
* Demonstrated ability to handle model calibration, class imbalance, and leakage prevention using real observational data.
* Experience with gradient-boosted methods such as LightGBM, XGBoost, or CatBoost.
* Experience with SHAP-based model explainability.
* Advanced Python skills, including NumPy, pandas, scikit-learn, and PyTorch.
* Strong SQL skills.
* Experience using Spark for large-scale feature engineering.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master's degree in mathematics, statistics, or applied mathematics with a data science concentration.
* Computer science or another quantitative degree may also be considered when academic transcripts and professional experience demonstrate equivalent mathematical depth.

**Additional Experience That Is a Plus**

* Published or open-source work involving tabular deep learning, sequence modeling over event data, or LLM evaluation.
* Experience with model quantization and large-scale CPU inference optimization.
* Experience working with healthcare claims or other administrative data, including diagnosis and procedure coding systems.
* Familiarity with fairness and subgroup evaluation methods in applied settings.
* Experience in FedRAMP, HIPAA, or other access-restricted environments.
* Active or prior federal Public Trust determination.

**Core Competencies**

* **Architecture Judgment:**
  Ability to select and justify model architectures using benchmarked baselines.
* **Self-Supervised Modeling:**
  Experience pretraining tabular and temporal transformers with outcome labels withheld.
* **Extraction Validation:**
  Ability to measure model-versus-human agreement before large-scale extraction.
* **Calibration Discipline:**
  Ability to report calibration alongside discrimination metrics and select thresholds based on error costs.
* **Mathematical Grounding:**
  Ability to explain the reasoning behind modeling methods, not simply how to use them.
* **Constrained Engineering:**
  Ability to deliver CPU-only inference within an approved-library environment.
* **Reproducibility:**
  Commitment to ensuring every reported result can be regenerated from a recorded MLflow run.

**Location & Work Arrangement**

* Remote position within the United States.
* Maryland-area candidates are preferred for occasional on-site collaboration.

* Employment type: Full-time, W-2.
* Experience level: 3+ years.

* This role supports federal programs and requires the ability to obtain a Public Trust or higher background determination.

* The posted salary range reflects the floor and target for the role. Actual offers depend on experience, certifications, and clearance level.
* Health, dental, and vision coverage.
* 401(k) with company contribution.
* Paid time off and federal holidays.
* Training and certification support.

Join Toyota Automated Logistics and write the software that makes autonomous vehicles move safely through real warehouses. The PLE team owns product variants, sustaining engineering, and select new product development across our growing portfolio — conveyors, AGVs, and emerging product lines — plus the test infrastructure that validates them. This role sits on the vehicle side: motion control, safety systems, and the onboard software that decides how our AGVs behave.
  
  
The PLE Software Developer/Engineer I develops and maintains the onboard software that controls our AGV product lines — from motion and navigation behavior, to the safety systems that protect people working alongside our vehicles, to the interfaces that connect a vehicle to the wider fleet and to fixed automation. This is an entry-level role built for a new graduate: you'll start with well-scoped features, bug fixes, and test development under the mentorship of senior engineers, and grow into ownership of vehicle subsystems as your judgment develops. As PLE’s capacity to support AI robotic vision systems matures, there is a path into perception and vision-guided autonomy work for engineers who want it. Reporting to the Product Line Engineering Systems & Testing Team Lead, you'll partner daily with controls, mechanical, and project engineering.
  
  
**Job Functions**
Vehicle Control Software Development
  
  

* Develop, test, and maintain onboard AGV software — motion control, navigation behavior, vehicle state management, error handling, and diagnostics.
* Implement well-scoped features, enhancements, and defect fixes across AGV product lines and variants, with design review and mentorship from senior engineers.
* Work with onboard controllers and embedded interfaces (CAN, serial, industrial Ethernet) and integrate vehicle software with higher-level PLC and fleet control.
* Contribute to code reviews, version control hygiene, and software documentation as a regular part of the development cycle.

Safety Systems & Compliance
  
  

* Support development and maintenance of AGV safety functions — obstacle detection, protective stop behavior, speed and zone enforcement, and E-stop logic.
* Implement and verify safety-related software under the direction of senior engineers, following applicable functional safety and industrial vehicle standards (ANSI/ITSDF B56.5, ISO 3691-4).
* Maintain traceability between safety requirements, implementation, and verification evidence to support product certification and audit.
* Participate in risk assessments, hazard analyses, and design reviews for vehicle safety behavior.

Testing, Validation & Debug
  
  

* Write and maintain unit, integration, and regression tests for vehicle software; support automated test development where it saves manual effort.
* Validate software on physical AGVs in the engineering lab and test cells — running scenarios, capturing data, and confirming behavior against requirements.
* Troubleshoot vehicle issues using logs, bus analyzers, and data capture tools; perform root cause analysis and drive fixes through to release.
* Support sustaining and field issue resolution across AGV product lines in partnership with project engineering and service.

Engineering Process & Growth Areas
  
  

* Work within the team's Agile cadence — JIRA backlog grooming, sprint commitments, and status transparency.
* Contribute to engineering process and software ownership within PLE, including PLM, design tools, code repositories, and version control practices.
* Grow into AI robotic vision work as the capability develops — perception pipelines, object and obstacle detection, sensor fusion, and vision-guided AGV behavior.
* Take on additional development scope, subsystem ownership, and technical decision-making as skills and product knowledge grow.

**Travel Requirements**

* 5% overnight travel (Travel expenses paid by Toyota Automated Logistics)

**Required Qualifications And Preferred Skills**

* BS in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Software Development, or a related technical discipline.
* 0–2 years of professional experience; new and recent graduates are encouraged to apply.
* Proficiency in at least one of C, C++, C#, or Python, with solid fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, and debugging.
* Working knowledge of version control (Git) and collaborative development practices such as branching and code review.
* Willingness to work hands-on with physical hardware in a lab and production environment.
* Strong documentation, communication, and organizational skills.
* Must be eligible to work in the USA long term without sponsorship.
* Employees must follow all information security policies, protect confidential data, complete required training, and report any suspected security incidents to support our information security controls.

Capital One is a technology-driven financial services company using data, machine learning, and artificial intelligence to make banking simpler and more useful. For years, the company has applied machine learning to create personalized, real-time customer experiences. Its AI capabilities help customers understand unusual charges, get answers to questions, and interact with financial services more easily. Capital One invests in modern technology infrastructure and talented teams to build reliable, scalable solutions that serve customers and business partners.
  
  
**About The Role**
Capital One is seeking an AI Engineer 3 to join its Intelligent Foundations and Experiences (IFX) team. This team partners across the company to advance AI science and engineering and to develop proprietary models and platforms used by teams throughout the business. In this role, you will help create foundational AI systems and product experiences that can deliver value at scale. You will work with engineers, research scientists, technical program managers, product managers, and data specialists to turn emerging AI capabilities into production-ready solutions.
  
  
This is a hybrid position, with on-site attendance required according to Capital One’s hybrid policy for your designated office. The role may be based in McLean, Virginia; New York, New York; or San Jose, California. The listed annual salary ranges are $161,800–$184,600 in McLean and $176,500–$201,400 in New York or San Jose. The final salary will depend on work location and will be stated in the offer letter.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Design, develop, test, deploy, and support AI software components, including foundation model training, large language model inference, similarity search, guardrails, evaluation, experimentation, governance, and observability. Build and benchmark multi-turn conversational and tool-using agent workflows, applying measurable performance and safety criteria. Develop scalable pipelines for training, fine-tuning, and deploying foundation or domain-specific models across environments.
  
  
Apply optimization techniques to improve production systems across cost, latency, throughput, scalability, and accuracy. Work with research and data engineering teams to curate datasets and strengthen evaluation methods. Contribute to model traceability, lineage documentation, version control, and security practices. Help shape the technical vision and long-term roadmap for foundational AI systems, mentor junior engineers, and promote reproducible, responsible experimentation. Use open-source and cloud technologies such as PyTorch, Hugging Face, vector databases, and AWS services as appropriate.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Applicants must have a bachelor’s degree in computer science, artificial intelligence, electrical engineering, computer engineering, or a related field and at least three years of experience developing AI or machine-learning algorithms or technologies; alternatively, a relevant master’s degree and at least one year of that experience. At least three years of programming experience with Python, Go, Scala, CUDA, or Java is required.
  
  
Preferred qualifications include experience deploying scalable, responsible AI solutions on AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, or private cloud; developing and supporting AI services; and optimizing training or inference for hardware utilization, latency, throughput, and cost. Experience with agentic AI, retrieval-augmented generation, vector databases, fine-tuning, LLM evaluation, prompt engineering, safety guardrails, and red-teaming is valuable. Strong engineering and mathematical foundations, curiosity about AI research, clear communication, adaptability, and a commitment to responsible technology are important for success.
  
  
**Benefits**

**Job Description**
**Join Akeneo’s Customer Engineering & Quality (CEQ) team, operating at the intersection of software engineering and real-world product usage. This role helps ensure customers experience a reliable, high-performing platform by digging into complex technical issues, resolving root causes, and proactively strengthening our systems.**
**What is great about this role and opportunity? This role offers a unique vantage point across the entire Akeneo Product Cloud, where you will see the immediate, tangible impact of your code on the people who rely on it every day. Rather than just clearing a ticket queue, you will trace problems across the full stack from application code and slow queries to background jobs and underlying infrastructure turning customer feedback and production data into lasting gains in performance, scalability, and cost-efficiency. Supported closely by experienced Senior and Staff Engineers, you will grow from shipping individual fixes to owning end-to-end architectural improvements in a collaborative, high-trust environment.**

* Drive proactive platform improvements: Turn customer feedback and production insights into lasting gains in system performance, reliability, observability, and cost-efficiency. Cutting recurring failures and manual work before they cause incidents.

* Monitor systems and improve observability: Use logs, metrics, and dashboards to track service health, refine instrumentation, and reduce alert noise so real customer-impacting issues stand out.

**What You Will Bring To The Team**

* Systematic debugging and analytical mindset: A natural curiosity for how systems behave post-deployment, paired with the ability to test hypotheses, distinguish symptoms from root causes, and navigate ambiguous problems using data and evidence.
* Responsible production habits and AI fluency: A thoughtful approach to safe deployments, rollbacks, and customer impact, combined with the ability to leverage modern AI coding tools (like Claude Code) to explore codebases and accelerate learning while maintaining strict data privacy and code ownership.
* Clear, empathetic communication: The ability to translate complex technical findings into clear updates for Product Support, cross-functional engineering teams, and teammates, while openly giving and receiving feedback.

**About Black Forest Labs**
We’re the team building the foundational layer for visual intelligence: multimodal models trained jointly on images, video, audio, and action to see, generate, and understand the world.
  
  
Our founding team pioneered latent diffusion and Stable Diffusion, the breakthroughs that made generative AI accessible to millions. With FLUX, we're pushing into generative media at scale, machines that act in the physical world, and emerging applications in computer use.
  
  
Our FLUX models top public benchmarks and run in production in some of the world's biggest platforms. We're a small, fast growing research lab competing with the largest companies in the world. From our labs in Freiburg to San Francisco, we're building what comes next.
  
  
****Why This Role****
Black Forest Labs’ products arm individuals with great creative power to produce novel media across a range of modalities. The quality of our models inevitably also gives bad actors the opportunity to create harmful, copyright-infringing, or illegal content.
  
  
In this role you will develop and improve our moderation system: a multilayered stack of detection models. Succeeding in this role requires creativity and familiarity with a large range of ML techniques. An effective solution that balances accuracy, cost, latency, and scalability will vary case-by-case, from classical ML fine-tuning, to RAG-based agents, to simple, lightweight semantic embeddings.
  
  
This is a Senior / Staff IC role. Our ideal candidate is able to work across the full stack of ML engineering, collaborate cross-functionally with many teams, including legal, policy, go-to market, and infra, and has a real interest in the domains of AI safety and integrity.
  
  
****What You’ll Work On****

* Develop ML models and systems to detect harmful and/or illegal content across a variety of classes and modalities
* Collaborate with our core infrastructure team to integrate these models into a large-scale production serving pipeline
* Handle customer requests and feedback on our moderation behavior, and make quick adjustments in response
* Collaborate with our legal, policy, and product teams to design moderation policies that are technically feasible and effective while preserving a positive user experience

****What We’re Looking For****

* Experience deploying VLMs at scale for the classification of multimodal content
* Experience building AI systems around state-of-the-art open-source VLMs
* Experience tuning models for classification tasks, including building eval sets, reasoning about precision/recall at threshold, and monitoring for drift
* Comfort with the full stack of ML engineering: from research and experimentation to large-scale deployment

Nice to have:
  
  

* Comfort with the adversarial nature of generative AI moderation: prompt obfuscation, jailbreaks, output laundering, and evasion generally
* Experience in moderation/safety space, preferably across a range of modalities (text, image, video, audio)
* Experience optimizing VLM inference latency at scale
* Experience with non-VLM solutions for safety classification (e.g., classical ML)
* Domain knowledge and experience with content copyright and/or child safety moderation systems

****How We Work Together****
We’re a distributed team with real offices that people actually use. This role is based in San Francisco, and you’ll join us in the office at least 2 days a week, or one full week every other week.
  
  
**Everything we do is grounded in four values:**

* Obsessed. We are a frontier research lab. The science has to be right, the understanding deep, the product beautiful.
* Low Ego. The work speaks. The best idea wins, no matter who said it. Credit is shared. Nobody is above any task.
* Bold. We take the ambitious bet. We ship, we do not wait for conditions to be perfect.
* Kind. People over politics. We treat each other with genuine warmth. Agency without empathy creates chaos.

If this sounds like work you’d enjoy, we’d love to hear from you.
  
  
**Base Annual Salary:**
**US**
$220,000 - $280,000 USD + Equity
  
  
Note: We may use AI-assisted tools to help organize applications. All hiring decisions are always made by our team.

The platform brings together an embedded real-time ledger, virtual accounts, and multiple payment methods—including cards, ACH, wires, RTP, and push-to-card—through a single programmable API.

Reporting to the VP of Engineering, you will play a key role in shaping the platform’s technical direction while remaining actively involved in writing production code. You will guide architecture decisions, strengthen system reliability and security, and help the engineering team work more efficiently as the business scales.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the design, development, and ongoing improvement of scalable, secure, high-performance distributed systems for payments and card processing.
* Influence architectural decisions across frontend, backend, data, and cloud infrastructure.
* Write high-quality, production-ready code using Angular, .NET Core, and SQL Server while setting strong engineering standards.
* Design and optimize RESTful APIs, microservices, and event-driven systems.
* Architect, deploy, and manage cloud-native solutions using Microsoft Azure.
* Promote CI/CD, DevOps practices, and automation to improve system reliability, development speed, and software quality.
* Use AI-enabled development tools to improve engineering productivity and software development lifecycle effectiveness.
* Ensure systems meet fintech requirements for security, compliance, availability, and auditability.
* Take ownership of high-impact engineering initiatives and deliver results in a fast-paced, growing business.

**Required Qualifications**

* Demonstrated experience working as a Principal Engineer or in an equivalent architect-level position.
* Deep expertise in distributed systems architecture and large-scale transaction platforms.
* Strong experience in fintech, payments, card issuing, or related financial infrastructure.
* Technical proficiency in modern Angular, C#/.NET Core, and SQL Server.
* Experience with Microsoft Azure and cloud-native solutions.
* Strong understanding of event-driven architecture, messaging systems, RESTful APIs, and microservices.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, and secure coding in regulated environments.
* Ability to lead through hands-on technical execution and production code.
* Strong ownership, accountability, and decision-making skills.
* Ability to work through ambiguity, adapt to changing priorities, and balance delivery speed with long-term scalability and maintainability.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to connect engineering decisions to business objectives.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience scaling systems in both startup and enterprise environments.

**Why Join Qolo?**

* Take meaningful ownership and influence technical decisions.
* Build enterprise-grade infrastructure in an environment without the typical enterprise bureaucracy.
* Help define engineering culture, standards, and long-term technical direction.

**About The Company**
CrowdStrike is a global cybersecurity leader protecting the people, processes, and technologies that power modern organizations. Since 2011, the company has focused on stopping breaches and has helped redefine security through its AI-native platform. Its systems operate at global scale, processing nearly three trillion events each day, with that volume continuing to grow. Customers across industries rely on CrowdStrike to help protect their businesses, communities, and the people they serve.
  
  
CrowdStrike is a mission-driven company using AI to transform how teams work and solve complex problems. Employees are encouraged to bring curiosity, innovation, and a strong customer focus to their work. The company values flexibility and autonomy while fostering responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and continuous learning.
  
  
**About The Role**
CrowdStrike is seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join its Infrastructure team. In this role, you will contribute to a global engineering organization building tools and systems that support the development, deployment, and observability of services across a large-scale distributed environment. Your work will help engineering teams operate efficiently and reliably as the platform and its data volumes continue to expand.
  
  
You will collaborate with engineers and stakeholders to understand infrastructure needs, design practical solutions, and deliver software that supports dependable operations. The role calls for thoughtful technical judgment, a focus on quality, and an interest in improving the systems and workflows that enable teams to build and run products. You will also contribute to a culture of responsible AI use, applying appropriate tools and experimentation to accelerate work and uncover useful insights.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Candidates should have substantial professional software engineering experience and the ability to design, implement, test, and maintain production-quality systems. A strong foundation in software development principles, distributed systems, and infrastructure engineering will help you succeed. Experience building internal tools, deployment systems, observability capabilities, or other services used by engineering teams is relevant to this position.
  
  
You should be comfortable working through complex technical challenges, evaluating trade-offs, and communicating decisions clearly. The ability to collaborate across teams, incorporate feedback, and take ownership of work from exploration through delivery is important. A commitment to reliability, security, maintainability, and customer impact is expected. Familiarity with AI-assisted workflows and a responsible, thoughtful approach to using AI in engineering are also valuable.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Design, develop, and maintain infrastructure software and engineering tools that support building, deploying, and observing services. Help improve the reliability, scalability, and operational effectiveness of systems that serve a global platform. Identify opportunities to simplify workflows, reduce friction for engineering teams, and strengthen the way services are operated.
  
  
Work with colleagues to understand requirements, assess technical options, and deliver maintainable solutions. Participate in design discussions, code reviews, testing, and troubleshooting, and share knowledge that helps improve team practices. Use data and operational feedback to identify issues and guide improvements. Apply AI tools responsibly where they can accelerate execution, support learning, or help solve complex problems, while maintaining sound engineering judgment and accountability.
  
  
**Benefits**
CrowdStrike offers a work environment centered on flexibility, autonomy, professional growth, and meaningful contributions to cybersecurity. Team members have opportunities to collaborate with colleagues across a global organization and work on systems operating at significant scale. The company encourages continuous learning, responsible innovation, and the exploration of AI as a practical force multiplier. Specific compensation, benefits, and work-arrangement details may vary by location and are shared during the hiring process.

Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube.
  
  
**Job Description**
At Shield AI, we are revolutionizing defense technology to protect service members and civilians with intelligent, autonomous systems. Our Integration Test Engineering team plays a critical role in ensuring the X-BAT remains the most reliable, mission-ready UAV in the industry. We design cutting-edge test solutions—custom-built electrical and systems that push our hardware to its limits in real-world and extreme environments integrated with a wide variety of instrumentation to assure mission integrity.
  
  
As an Electrical Engineer on our Hardware Test team, you’ll have the opportunity to design and automate test systems that validate everything from power electronics to RF communications. You'll work hands-on with PCB design, Python scripting, and advanced environmental testing (HASS, ESS, HALT) to ensure the highest standards of reliability. If you're passionate about building rock-solid hardware and thrive in a fast-paced, multidisciplinary environment, this role is for you.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Design and own test systems for critical UAV electrical system test, from concept to validation.
* Work across multiple EE disciplines, including power electronics, RF, communications, and system integration.
* Develop PCBs to interface between test stands and the device-under-test (DUT).
* Build custom test fixtures integrating PCBAs, Test Equipment, and harnessing for automated and high-fidelity testing.
* Automate test sequences using Python, ensuring repeatability, efficiency, and scalability.
* Collaborate in cross-functional design reviews, advocating for testability improvements that streamline hardware validation.
* Adapt and innovate in a fast-moving, high-stakes environment, where your work directly impacts mission success.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Required Qualifications**

* B.S. in Electrical Engineering or equivalent hands-on experience.
* Strong foundation in electrical, mechanical, and software engineering principles.

is a research lab investigating the boundaries of artificial intelligence through novel datasets and experimentation. We're backed by top investors, including Y Combinator and Box Group, and support all leading AI labs.

BenchmarkAI publishes investment research and indexes. ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Grok each run their own investment teams across 160 portfolios, and we publish what they decide and why. If we're successful, our business looks more like S&P Global than Bridgewater or BlackRock.

**Read this first:**
https://www.benchmarkai.app/about/investment-system. When you apply, tell us one thing in it you'd change or test next. That note tells us more than a resume.

You'll build and run the system behind the BenchmarkAI Indexes. Every day, 5 agents across 4 frontier models research the market. Every month, 160 portfolios research, decide and rebalance in about 40 hours. You'll make that faster, cheaper and harder to break.

**Pay:**
$150,000 to $250,000 a year, plus equity. Every full-time offer includes equity, unlimited paid time off, premium health insurance and quarterly offsites. Salary ranges run from the low end of a remote offer to the high end of a San Francisco one.

**Location:**
Remote in US time zones, or Miami, New York or San Francisco.

**Level:**
Mid-level. You've done this job before, and you still do the work yourself.

**What you'll do**

* **Own the runs.**
  Daily research and the monthly rebalance. Make every run finish, and know what it costs.
* **Build the deterministic layer.**
  The data, screens and tools the agents call. This code has to give the same answer every time.
* **Ship what people read.**
  The research pages, the index pages and the research plugin that brings our research into people's own AI assistants.
* **Direct the agents.**
  Agents write much of our code. You tell them what to build, review what they write and own what ships.

**What we're looking for**

* **You're an AI super user.**
  You build with coding agents every day and know where they fail.
* **You've shipped LLM systems to production.**
  Long-running jobs, structured outputs, evaluations and a bill you had to explain.
* **You've built production systems on real data.**
  Data that has to reconcile, every time.
* **You protect the record.**
  A published number or decision never changes after the fact. You build so it can't.

**What we're not looking for**

* **The rewriter.**
  Wants a new architecture before shipping the fix.
* **The ticket taker.**
  Waits for a spec. Here you write it.

More about the team and how we work: https://www.benchmarkai.app/careers

CFO AI, Inc. (BenchmarkAI) is an equal opportunity employer. If you need an accommodation to apply or interview, email careers@benchmarkai.app.

**Required Qualifications**

* 2+ years of real-world software engineering experience (full-time or substantive internships count)
* Strong fundamentals in at least one major programming language
* Reliable, detail-oriented, and able to work independently
